purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Trishal

queries.query: Trishal Bangladesh cadastral map parcel land records official
queries.result: First-party results identified the official DLRS Online Land Records and Survey Management map/search portal, the official Trishal Upazila page, and the Trishal Upazila Land Office page. The DLRS portal exposes a public map workflow, but anonymous Trishal survey traversal did not return an upazila list and no parcel geometry was obtained.

queries.query: ত্রিশাল বাংলাদেশ মৌজা মানচিত্র খতিয়ান ভূমি অফিস সরকারি
queries.result: First-party Bengali results identified the official Trishal Upazila page, the official Trishal Upazila Land Office page, and the official DLRS map/search portal. The local pages evidence Trishal land administration and mouza coverage; they do not publish a safe anonymous parcel feature layer. The DLRS public route was inspected without login and returned no Trishal upazila options for the selected survey request.

registryEvidence.custodian: Trishal Upazila Land Office and Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS).
registryEvidence.locality: The official Trishal Upazila Land Office page identifies the উপজেলা ভূমি অফিস, ত্রিশাল, ময়মনসিংহ; the official Trishal Upazila page reports local land/revenue administration and mouza statistics.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes a local land-office custodian and national cadastral/survey custodian, not public parcel-data availability, citywide coverage, currentness or legal title coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: The current official map page and MapSearch.js were inspected. The viewer defines public POST/GET routes for division, district, survey, upazila, mouza, sheet, sheet GeoJSON and safe plot lookup. Division and Mymensingh district traversal succeeded; the Mymensingh RS survey endpoint returned RS 201901 (আরএস, চলমান), but the subsequent public upazila request returned an empty array. No safe ID+geometry response was available, so no GeoJSON was retained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official public map/search page retrieved over TLS; it exposed the current map controls and script route.
Current viewer JavaScript retrieved; it defines the public hierarchy and map/API routes, including GetSheetJsonBySurvey and GetKhatianDataList_MapSearch.
Initial empty POST returned HTTP 411 Length Required; retry with an empty form body succeeded and returned the official division list, including Mymensingh code 070000000.
For division 070000000, returned official district data including Mymensingh code 070300000 and company code 4171.
Initial request with the wrong company code returned an empty list; retry with district 070300000 and company code 4171 returned RS survey 201901, status চলমান.
For Mymensingh district 070300000, company code 4171 and survey 201901, returned an empty JSON array; no Trishal upazila code was exposed for the next traversal step.
Official Trishal Upazila page retrieved; it reports land/revenue administration, including 91 mouzas and 11 union land offices.
Official Trishal Upazila Land Office page retrieved; it identifies the local office and location.
Official Bengali Trishal map/location page retrieved; it provides administrative geography, not parcel geometry.
Official DLRS portal retrieved; it links to survey/map services but did not provide an additional anonymous Trishal parcel layer.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point [24.5776979509509, 90.3836042372999] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point query was possible.
The empty upazila response may reflect survey coverage, endpoint behavior, request parameters or a transient service condition; it is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The official local land-office evidence establishes a registry/custodian presence, but not public parcel geometry, complete Trishal coverage, currentness or legal title coverage.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS exception was used.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
